ChatCompletion.description_en: Completes a conversation with the EMR AI assistant. This operation receives user messages, invokes the EMR intelligent assistant for inference, and returns the assistant's reply token by token in Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming mode. Multi-turn conversations are supported by using a sessionId to maintain context
ChatCompletion.description_zh: EMR AI 助手对话补全接口。接收用户的对话消息,调用 EMR 智能助手进行推理,以 SSE 流式方式逐 token 返回助手回复。支持多轮会话(通过 sessionId 续接上下文)
